name: Panoply
description_en:
Panoply is a product in the Data integration category. Its directory profile covers Data Transformation, Data Filtering, Data Extraction, API Integration, Match & Merge, Master Data Management, Data Quality Control, Metadata Management.

Additional listed capabilities include Compliance Tracking, Data Integration, Data Analysis. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $325.0. Offers Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: convert data into a required format or structure; combine information from connected sources. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Panoply 属于数据集成软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括数据转换、数据筛选、数据提取、API 集成、匹配与合并、主数据管理、数据质量控制、元数据管理。

资料还列出合规事项跟踪、数据集成、数据分析。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $325.0. 另有定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：将数据转换为所需格式或结构；整合来自已连接数据源的信息。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: The former panoply.io homepage and pricing now identify an independent publication operated by Lumination AI Limited, explicitly unaffiliated with the former Panoply product, SQream or Scailium. Its claim of 2026 discontinuation is not adopted as an authoritative vendor notice. SQream still hosts a February 2024 Panoply release and old product navigation. Current operator, service availability, contract and shutdown timing remain unresolved; not counted complete.
research_gaps.zh: 原 panoply.io 首页及定价现明确自称 Lumination AI Limited 运营的独立出版站，与旧 Panoply 产品、SQream 或 Scailium 无关联。未把该站的 2026 年停服说法当权威厂商通知。SQream 仍保留 2024 年 2 月 Panoply 公告及旧产品导航。当前运营者、服务可用性、合同及停服时间仍未确定，不计入完成。
